summary.en: Container manager that ships a setup-arm64.exe installer.
summary.zh-TW: 提供 setup-arm64.exe 安裝檔的容器管理工具。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Running containers needs WSL 2 or a Podman machine; that part was not checked.
caveats.zh-TW: 執行容器需要 WSL 2 或 Podman machine，此部分未檢查。
